title: Plugin Event
description: One observation a Plugin drops into the Inbox for Ingest to consume. See CONTEXT.md: Plugin, Plugin Event, Inbox, Ingest; ADR 0013.

plugin.description: The Plugin that produced this event, e.g. "govee_ble", "tuya_lan" — matches sensor.plugin/plug.plugin.

external_id.description: The opaque per-Plugin device id this event is about — matches sensor.external_id/plug.external_id for the same plugin. See CONTEXT.md: External ID.

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp of the observation itself (not when Ingest processed it), formatted exactly like SQLite's datetime('now') — "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS", no 'T', no timezone suffix — so it sorts and compares correctly against every other recorded_at column in the database.

sensor_reading_payload.description: See CONTEXT.md: Reading. Any subset may be present — a plugin only reports what its device actually measures.

plug_state_payload.description: See CONTEXT.md: Ingest. Reported on every poll, not just on change — Ingest does the edge-detection.

plug_telemetry_payload.description: See CONTEXT.md: Data Capture. Written on a slower, independent cadence from plug_state; any subset may be present, or all null if the device exposes no telemetry.
